about: P01 guest web: the screens that are views in the client's Guest Booking v2 website and its Visit Planner, from the 30 September return (WebApp_30thSep.zip, sources/designs/guest-rev3-30-september). Captured with tools/capture-prototype.mjs in viewport mode (1440 x 900, the page as the guest sees it; proof texts must be on screen). The screens chosen are the ones this return or the 29 September audit changed on the website: the booking flows of the 30 September feedback (multi-park counters WEB-005, surf session tickets WEB-006, transport WEB-049), the At the venue tabs (WEB-036, 039, 040, 041, 042, 043, 046) and the Visit Planner (WEB-050, which had no frame). Flows are chosen in the prototype's engine controls (Venue type, then the Booking flow list), then Book; the At the venue screens pick Theme park (Summit Peaks) first, because the prototype remembers the last venue between page loads. **Every client-verified screen with a view here has an entry** (21 October 2026, CHG-R9UI-004: the WEB-007 seat page was built bare and no reference capture of it existed): an entry with `pending` names the view and has no click path yet (capture-prototype.mjs lists it as pending); `verified: false` marks steps written from the prototype's source and not run yet.
